sentence: In many countries, it's a ___ to remove your shoes before entering a house.
explanation: Un <custom> es una manera tradicional de hacer las cosas en una cultura.
tip: 6 letters — means 'costumbre' (not 'tradition')

sentence: Good table ___ includes not talking with your mouth full.
explanation: <Etiquette> se refiere a las reglas del comportamiento educado.
tip: A French-origin word meaning 'modales' or rules of polite behavior

sentence: We ___ my grandmother's birthday with a big party.
explanation: <Celebrate> significa hacer algo especial para una ocasión feliz.
tip: Complete with the correct form of <celebrate>

sentence: She will ___ the dinner party at her apartment.
explanation: <Host> significa organizar un evento y recibir a los invitados.
tip: 4-letter verb — the person who invites guests (= anfitrión, as a verb)

sentence: The doctor wrote a ___ for some antibiotics.
explanation: Una <prescription> es una orden escrita de un médico para obtener medicamentos.
tip: Starts with 'pre-' — a doctor's written order for medicine

sentence: He stayed home because he had a high ___.
explanation: Una <fever> es cuando la temperatura corporal es más alta de lo normal.
tip: 5 letters — 'fiebre' in English

sentence: I have a dental ___ next Monday.
explanation: Un <check-up> es un examen de rutina realizado por un médico o dentista.
tip: Hyphenated word: <check> + <up> = routine examination

sentence: Which web ___ do you use? Chrome or Firefox?
explanation: Un <browser> es un programa que se usa para acceder a sitios web en internet.
tip: Chrome and Firefox are examples of a web ___

sentence: The hotel has free ___ for all guests.
explanation: <Wi-Fi> es el acceso a internet inalámbrico.
tip: Wireless internet connection — 4 characters with a hyphen

sentence: Eating grapes at midnight is a Spanish New Year ___.
explanation: Una <tradition> es una costumbre que se transmite de generación en generación.
tip: 9 letters — 'tradición' in English

sentence: A headache can be a ___ of stress.
explanation: Un <symptom> es una señal que indica un problema de salud.
tip: 7 letters — 'síntoma' in English

sentence: Take this ___ twice a day after meals.
explanation: <Medicine> es una sustancia que se usa para tratar enfermedades.
tip: 8 letters — 'medicina' in English

sentence: I made an ___ with the dentist for Friday.
explanation: Una <appointment> es una cita programada a una hora específica.
tip: 11 letters — a scheduled meeting with a professional (= cita)

sentence: You can ___ the app from the App Store.
explanation: <Download> significa transferir archivos de internet a tu dispositivo.
tip: Complete with the correct form of <download> — internet → device

sentence: Your ___ must have at least 8 characters.
explanation: Una <password> es un código secreto que se usa para proteger tus cuentas.
tip: 8 letters — 'contraseña' in English

sentence: I need to ___ these photos to my social media.
explanation: <Upload> significa enviar archivos desde tu dispositivo a internet.
tip: Complete with the correct form of <upload> — device → internet

sentence: The graduation ___ was very emotional.
explanation: Una <ceremony> es un evento formal con tradiciones especiales.
tip: 8 letters — 'ceremonia' in English

sentence: She can't eat peanuts because she has an ___.
explanation: Una <allergy> es una reacción negativa a ciertas sustancias.
tip: 7 letters — 'alergia' in English

sentence: Visit our ___ for more information about the course.
explanation: Un <website> es un conjunto de páginas en internet.
tip: 7 letters — 'sitio web' in English (one word)

sentence: The summer music ___ attracts thousands of visitors.
explanation: Un <festival> es un evento de celebración organizado.
tip: 8 letters — same word as in Spanish!
